content.content: Resolution can be answered from the set of node documents already read. A target is the root, a loaded sibling, absent, or failed; the outcome is the same as the file-backed resolution, and no per-target read is made.
content.rationale: The file-backed resolution reads the target at its change for every edge; the set read already holds the same documents, so resolving from the set yields the same outcome without the crossing. This elaborates `D-read-bulk`'s crossing invariant and keeps S2-resolve's one-path rule: the set-backed entry point is the same rule, not a second one.
